'idealerweise' (ideally) is an inline marker. I read it as governing the whole clause up to 'und MCP', so MCP is nice_to_have.
MCP's raw_text is the bare name. The guide requires the marker in the quote only for appetite-rule labels (rule 3), and this label rests on rule 2.
'AI- Engineering' has no exact taxonomy entry. I did not map it to ml-engineering or ai-ml, and left it unmapped.
'Frameworks wie' names no taxonomy skill. I did not add the 'llm-orchestration' parent, because the posting never names it.
I mapped 'agentenbasierten KI-Systemen' to agents. This is a German paraphrase with no exact alias, so it is flagged uncertain.
Seniority rests on 'Mindestens zwei Jahre' (at least two years). That is at the 0-2 boundary, so I labeled it junior and flagged it.
The German level 'B12' is likely a typo for B1/B2. It is required either way.
'vergleichbaren Fachrichtung' (comparable field) widens the field only, so degree_or_equivalent is false.
I left DSGVO/EU AI Act unmapped as governance/regulatory domain knowledge. I did not force it onto data-privacy-and-security.
